lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15 high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region, arranged in three discernible horizontal rows forming a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity values on the upper margin and low-intensity shadow values on the lower margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular-shaped patch of high luminance with diffuse edges is located on the upper-mid flank, approximately dorsal to the posterior insertion of the pectoral fin.
